2025_059_october_2025_pcard_report.paragraph: Troy School District's monthly purchasing-card expenditure listing for October 2025, carried on the December 16, 2025 Board of Education agenda, itemizes every P-Card charge posted to district accounts under the journal-entry description "OCT 2025 PCARD EXP." Each line gives a posting date, a 19-digit accounting code, the merchant description as it appeared on the card statement, and the transaction amount; posting dates run from 8/27/25 through 10/31/25. The report runs 60 numbered pages, each footed 12/11/25, and closes with a stated total of 411,501.90. The single largest line is a GRAINGER charge of 9,907.22 posted 10/1/25 to accounting code 4231602840000006410.
2025_059_october_2025_pcard_report.page:
**What it is**
A transaction-level purchasing-card (PCARD) report for Troy School District covering October 2025, submitted to the Board of Education for the meeting of December 16, 2025. Every page repeats the banner "TROY SCHOOL DISTRICT, PCARD report, October 2025" and the column headings "J E descrip / Posting Date / Accounting Code / Description / Transaction Amount." All lines carry the journal-entry description OCT 2025 PCARD EXP. Pages are numbered 1 through 60 and footed with the print date 12/11/25.

**Reported total**
The listing ends with a single figure, 411,501.90. No subtotals, fund recaps, cardholder names or approval signatures appear.

The opening pages consist almost entirely of repeated CORPORATE ANNUAL FEE lines of 3.00 each, all posted 8/27/25 and all coded to 1016682520245003190 - one line per card in the program.
